geometry_edits.rationale: Replace the radial array with a continuous bar to establish one legible hall-like dominant mass.
Make the bend shallow so the form remains a clear-span hall rather than a fragmented pinwheel.
Keep the roof section as a shed/daylight hall expression, but with a clearer span logic.
Preserve the long-span direction so the section reads as a gym hall rather than a vertical object.
Add a courtyard macro to carve a public entry/court condition while keeping the hall in ancestry.
Tune the courtyard margin to create a readable public void at the edge.
Make the new courtyard wrapper the root so the hall remains in ancestry and the public void becomes legible.

graph_edits.rationale: Replace the radial cluster logic with a continuous bent bar/hall gesture to restore a clear long-span primary mass.
Reduce radial spread so the dominant mass reads as one anchored span instead of a star-like aggregation.
Introduce a public court/void as a legible ground response to the frontage and a more gym-appropriate arrival figure.
Keep the void substantial but not parcel-consuming; it should read as public ground rather than leftover clipping.

rationale: The candidate reads as a tightly wound, star-like object with multiple overlapping triangular planes and no convincing long-span hall hierarchy. In all views the mass is coherent only as a sculptural cluster, not as one clear gymnasium volume with subordinate support or a legible roof/section strategy. The top and front views especially suggest radial fragmentation and heavy self-overlap rather than a usable clear-span interior. There is no meaningful public void, court, or access seam along the presumed frontage, and the geometry feels closer to a torqued tower/object than a gymnasium. Repair integrity is moderate because the shape is self-consistent as a manifold mass, but semantically it fails the program contract.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is coherent sports architecture, but it is more rectilinear and open-edge than this candidate’s torqued, fragmented mass.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Long-span sports envelope with a clear public edge and readable hall datum.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A low hall-like bar paired with a generous court/foreground void and strong ground occupation.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate lacks a comparable legible roof-hall relationship and instead reads as a wrapped cluster.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Single expressive roof line over an open front court supports gym/court semantics well.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This is typologically wrong for a gymnasium and should not be imitated beyond a possible caution against over-verticalization.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Counterfactual only: vertical torqued stack demonstrates a different spatial principle of towered massing.

warnings: Fails program hard gate for gymnasium: no clear-span hall, no subordinate support bar, and no roof/daylight logic legible in section.
Visible form is coherent mainly as a sculptural object; it is not coherent as a gym typology.
No legible public void or access response to the frontage is evident.
Do not overvalue the radial/star geometry; it conflicts with the required hall semantics.
